body.name: Launchbox v2.4.0 — speculative decode rewrite
body.body:
Launchbox v2.4.0 lands the speculative-decode rewrite: draft/target verify is now fused into the sampler loop, cutting decode latency ~30% on A100 and H100. This release also fixes the tokenizer round-trip regression from v2.3.2, bumps the minimum CUDA to 12.4, and adds per-request KV-cache offload hints. Full notes in the changelog; docker images are published as fixture-oss/launchbox:v2.4.0. Upgrade requires no config changes.

## Highlights

- Fused speculative decode in the sampler loop
- Tokenizer round-trip regression fixed
- CUDA 12.4 minimum

Anything past this point only exists to push the recorded body well beyond the excerpt cap so truncation is exercised.
